neil: FYI team — rolling maintenance and a small orchestration tweak tomorrow 2026-03-26 14:00 UTC. Not a major release but important for reducing head-of-line blocking in the router. Please scan and shout blockers.

neil: Overview:
- Maintenance window: 14:00-15:30 UTC (keep changes minimal during this slot).
- Change: switch router default queueing policy from FIFO to SLO-priority for short requests.
- Canary sequence: 2% for 20m -> 20% for 40m -> full based on health checks.
- Quick rollback: policy toggle back to FIFO via `rctl feature toggle router_fifo --off`

rita: Quick question: will this affect long-running streaming calls?

neil: Good call — streaming remains on a dedicated path, unaffected. This only alters request prioritization for short text-gen requests.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: maintenance window created: 2026-03-26T14:00:00Z - 2026-03-26T15:30:00Z  mw-id: mw-2164209876

mei: I can add an extra perf probe to the canary job to monitor tail latency for the short-gen path. Suggest adding a synthetic that runs 1s/5s cadence.

neil: Please do. Health gates for the canary:
- 5xx rate <= 0.1% over 5m
- p99 latency delta <= +10%
- SLO-priority queue depth not exceeding baseline by >15%
If any gate trips, full revert to FIFO.

rita: For Dedicated clusters: no change unless the customer opts in. We should send a brief note to Dedicated teams with opt-in instructions.

release-czar: Will add a short blurb to the weekly changelog under "routing infra" and schedule a company-wide reminder at T-2h. Also prepping a TL;DR email for infra partners.

mei: Canary commands I plan to run:
- `rctl canary start --service=router --percent=2 --note="slo-priority canary"`
- probe: `./ci/probes/short_gen_tail_check.sh --interval 5s`

neil: Thanks. If the canary looks good after the 20m check, bump to 20% then reassess at 40m. If all gates pass, flip at end of window. Otherwise revert immediately.

rita: Rollback steps (fastest):
1) `rctl feature toggle router_fifo --on`
2) `rctl canary set --service=router --percent=0`
3) `kubectl scale deployment/router -n infra --replicas=<prev>`
Links: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/router-priority, changelog draft: https://redwood.internal/changelogs/weekly-2026-03-26

neil: Great. I'll post live markers here during the canary (start, 20m-check, 60m-check, flip/revert). Ping me if you see any odd scheduling behavior. :eyes:
